name: usosrst
build: build.cmd (WDK 7.1, x86 WXP environment); not byte-reproducible (PE time stamp, PDB GUID)
imports: 46: ntoskrnl, hal; all resolve on the Windows 2000 SP4 ntoskrnl/ntkrnlmp and every 2000 HAL
build_nt4: build-nt4.cmd (same source, -DUSOSRST_NT4, PE version 4.00 via tools/nt4/pe_nt4_version.py) -> bin/nt4/i386/usosrst.sys, version string usosrst 1.5-nt4
imports_nt4: 40: ntoskrnl, hal; all resolve on the NT 4.0 RTM (1381.1) and SP6a (1381.335) ntoskrnl/ntkrnlmp and hal/halmps/halapic
nt4_1_5: 1.5-nt4 (2026-10-07): cuts the VGA window A0000h-BFFFFh out of HARDWARE\RESOURCEMAP\System Resources\Reserved (CSMWrap reports A0000h-FFFFFh as E820 reserved; NT 4.0 videoprt then refuses vga.sys -> STOP C0000143 DISPLAY DRIVER.DLL); load line "vga" + o/-/x. The Windows 2000 binary bin/i386 is unchanged (NT4-only code).
build_nt351: build-nt351.cmd (same source, -DUSOSRST_NT4 -DUSOSRST_NT351, PE version 3.51 via tools/nt4/pe_nt4_version.py --version 3.51) -> bin/nt351/i386/usosrst.sys, version string usosrst 1.6-nt351 (1.6: the AHCI heartbeat reads PCI configuration space through CF8h/CFCh, so it also works with the PCI BIOS hidden by the NT 3.x MBR)
imports_nt351: no KiBugCheckData, KeSetTimer re-armed by the DPC instead of KeSetTimerEx, no ZwSetSystemTime; every import resolves on the NT 3.51 ntoskrnl/hal (tools/tests/data/nt351_exports.txt)
